calibration.fit_policy: max normal-fit eligible prefix statistic times1.2, floor log(2); fixed online configuration selected on reused development wafers

composition: Preserve every core alert byte-for-byte. Keep every candidate alert as separately identified supplementary evidence. Candidate emitted state never touches core emitted state. W14/W18 have same-scan overlapping categories; W23 has earlier supplementary and later original spread_down.
timing_method: One measured traversal/wafer after normal-fit work; alternating core/candidate order by filename ordinal; parsing/hash/diagnostics/state traversal excluded. Active>=32. Raw samples retained. Development workstation, no SDK/deadline or repeatable speedup claim.

synthetic.design: 20 fixed random.Random Gaussian seeds per control; 100 independent tests, four interleaved sites; fixed unit scales/log(2) gate; no fit on controls
synthetic.location_step: Variance remains one but mean jumps +100 after six observations/site. This adversarial control tests whether transient location change is misclassified as spread contraction.
synthetic.localized: Ten of 100 tests on site1 change SD 10 to 0.1 at observation11; other sites/tests stay unit SD.
synthetic.isolated: Only one or two of 100 tests decrease SD 1 to0.1 at observation11.
